anomalies.description: A violent internal explosion erupts inside a building corridor, sending debris, sparks, and a shockwave outward; a chair is visible mid-air amid the blast.; A large external explosion occurs on the facade of a modern building, producing a massive fireball, smoke plume, and ejection of structural fragments; the blast propagates outward over several seconds.

A large external explosion occurs on the facade of a modern building, ejecting a massive plume of dark smoke and debris outward; visible in frames f0–f2 showing the initial blast and expanding smoke column, and f3 showing internal debris and sparks from the impact.
A secondary internal explosion or detonation occurs in a damaged interior space, generating intense sparks, flying debris, and a bright flash followed by lingering fire and smoke.

Residual effects of the explosion continue: thick smoke billows from upper floors and roofline, with visible structural damage (e.g., missing wall section) and lingering fire glow; seen in frames f11–f15.
A red laser dot appears on the chest of a man in a dark suit, indicating he is being targeted by a laser-sighted weapon.

A woman in a red suit fires a rifle from a white speedboat; muzzle flash is visible at the barrel.; A woman in a red suit fires a handgun from a white speedboat; muzzle flash is clearly visible at the barrel.
A large explosion occurs, likely on or near the boat, producing a cloud of smoke, debris, and sparks; the red laser dot from earlier frames is still visible amid the chaos.
A man in a dark suit is seen holding a handgun in a smoky, fiery environment; though no muzzle flash is visible, the context and weapon pose strongly suggest active shooting or imminent discharge.
